# Nathaniel Brook

Contracts attorney who reviewed my [[standard-services-agreement]] in June 2025. Found through [[rosalind-ng]], who uses him for her own contracts.

## How we work together

- Flat-fee reviews rather than hourly: $1,200 for the 2025 agreement, including one round of redlines and a 60-minute call ([[contract-review-with-nathaniel-brook-2025-06-20]]).
- He writes short comments in the margin and explains the reason for each, which is why I can now judge small client edits myself ([[contract-review-notes-nathaniel-brook-2025-06]]).
- I go back to him only for new terms or when a client asks for changes to liability, IP or indemnity. That happened twice: a short check of the Lintel Kit license in October 2025 ($150), and Copperline's procurement redlines in December 2025, a 30-minute call billed at $250.

## Current threads

- None open. If I form a company ([[business-structure-review]]) he would update the agreement to the new party name and check the Gumroad license text at the same time.
